notes.title: Game Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that after extensive development and effort, we are planning to officially release the game in August 2023.

Over the past few weeks, we have been waiting for the qualification approval for the Steam Visual Novel Festival, and we have previously mentioned that our release timing would depend on obtaining the exhibition qualification. However, as of the time of this announcement, our qualification is still under review, and we cannot provide an exact outcome. To give you a more accurate estimate of our release timing, we have decided to officially announce that we will launch in August.

We understand your anticipation for our game, and our team will continue to work diligently to ensure the highest quality and player experience. We aim to bring you endless fun and excitement with this game, and we believe you will be satisfied with our efforts.

Additionally, we would like to take this opportunity to call for experienced team members in internationalization and localization. We hope to bring the game to players around the world, and we are seeking a professional team that can help us achieve this goal. If you are interested or have any questions or suggestions regarding the game, please feel free to reach out to us at support@agcgames.com.

Once again, we appreciate your support and patience with our game. We are eagerly looking forward to sharing this meticulously crafted game with you and providing an unforgettable gaming experience. Stay tuned for the official release in August 2023!

Thank you!

AGC Games
